        <script><![CDATA[var ProjectDetailsAPI = Class.create();
ProjectDetailsAPI.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    submitChangeRequest: function() {
        var result = {
            success: false,
            error: ''
        };

        try {
            // Get data from the Portal
            var projectId = this.getParameter('sysparm_project_id');
            var changeData = JSON.parse(this.getParameter('sysparm_change'));

            // Create the record
            var grChange = new GlideRecordsecure('project_change_request');
            grChange.initialize();
            grChange.parent = projectId;
            grChange.short_description = changeData.short_description;
            grChange.category = changeData.category;
            grChange.priority = changeData.priority;
            grChange.impact = changeData.impact;
            grChange.description = changeData.description;
            
            // Custom fields for GateNow
            grChange.x_sysus_grant_life_reason_for_change = changeData.reason;
            grChange.x_sysus_grant_life_proposed_change = changeData.proposed_change;

            var newId = grChange.insert();

            if (newId) {
                result.success = true;
                // Get the display values to send back to the UI list
                result.change = {
                    sys_id: newId,
                    short_description: grChange.getValue('short_description'),
                    category_label: grChange.getDisplayValue('category'),
                    priority_label: grChange.getDisplayValue('priority'),
                    impact_label: grChange.getDisplayValue('impact'),
                    state_label: grChange.getDisplayValue('state'),
                    submitted_on: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()
                };
            } else {
                result.error = "Insert failed. Check permissions.";
            }
        } catch (e) {
            result.error = e.message;
        }

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },

    type: 'ProjectDetailsAPI'
});]]></script>
